thread:
Maya: FYI p99 on /v1/streaming is jittering after the routing-policy rebalance. p50/p95 steady, p99 swings +150-300ms. Anyone else see this? :confused:
Tess: Likely sampling/provenance issue. Did the rebalance push traffic into a path with different telemetry sampling?
Maya: Yes, ~28% of traffic moved to fallback pool that applies 1/15 ingress sampling. Window counts went from ~24k -> ~1.6k.
Aj: That will blow up p99. We merge t-digests; when one digest is heavily downsampled the merged tail can be dominated by noise.
Samir: Ops problem: oncall pages on p99 thresholds and they don't know when to ignore caused-by-sampling artifacts. We should make that visible.
Tess: Proposal (minimal first step): show a tiny "n=..." badge beside each percentile and a hover line: "origin=ingress-sampled | merged_count=180 | raw_count=1620 | routing_snapshot=rw-2026-03-25-09:12"
Ivy: UI note: badge should be subtle, non-blocking. If n < 1000 render a faint warning triangle and hover text: "low sample confidence: percentile unstable".
Aj: Backend: add `merged_count` required and optional `raw_count` to the rollup proto plus an `origin` enum (raw, ingress_sampled, aggregator_downsampled). Aggregator must preserve counts during tdigest downsampling.
Maya: Can we also capture the routing-policy revision id used when the rollup was created? That will help correlate noisy p99s with policy changes.
Samir: Good call. Add `routing_snapshot_id` string to rollups. We'll store the weight vector hash and policy id.
Tess: UX guard: if p99 delta > 50ms and merged_count < 200 annotate the series with: "Likely telemetry sampling or routing artifact. See rollup provenance." Link to rollup snapshot.
Aj: Implementation caveat: historical rollups won't have raw_count. Make UI fall back to merged_count and only show raw_count when present. Tests should cover tdigest merges with unequal n to validate merged_count semantics.
Ivy: Also plan a feature-flagged rollout of the UI change to internal users first. Add an accessibility string for the badge.
Samir: Oncall playbook update: add a quick checklist: 1) check sample badge, 2) open rollup snapshot to view routing_snapshot_id, 3) search recent routing-policy changes.
Maya: Can we gate auto-alerts? If a p99 alert triggers and the annotation rule fires (delta>50ms && merged_count dropped>75%) suppress external alerts and notify internal eng-platform only.
Tess: Sounds reasonable. We'll make suppression configurable per SLO.
deploy-bot: infra: created issue #4310 "expose-rollup-counts-and-routing-provenance" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4310 assigned Tess, Aj, Samir.
Aj: I'll sketch the proto change and a small aggregator patch. ETA 4d for unit tests.
Ivy: UI mock in Figma in the issue, will include badge states (normal/low-confidence/missing).
Samir: I'll run a quick scan to list endpoints with p99 spikes that co-occurred with sample_count drops and paste in the issue.
Maya: Thanks all. Once this lands we should see way fewer false-positive p99 escalations during routing rollouts.
Tess: Adding migration notes and rollout plan to the issue; will ping product for acceptance criteria.
